edges.effect_quant: The best pooled estimate comes from a 2023 meta-analysis of 50 randomized trials and 2,525 participants, where chicory-derived inulin-type fructans raised Bifidobacterium abundance with a standardized mean difference of 0.83 (95% CI 0.58-1.08).
edges.population: adults or older adults receiving chicory-derived or other inulin-type prebiotic supplementation
edges.mechanism: Long-chain inulin reaches the colon intact and selectively feeds saccharolytic bacteria, especially bifidobacteria, which can outcompete less favorable taxa when fermentable substrate delivery is sustained over days to weeks.
edges.summary: This is one of the cleaner microbiome edges in the whole consumer stack. Direct long-chain inulin trials and broader inulin-type fructan syntheses both point in the same direction: bifidobacteria usually rise when people take enough inulin for long enough.
edges.caveats: The size of the bifidogenic shift depends on baseline microbiota, gastrointestinal health, and the exact fructan chemistry. Studies in IBS or other GI disorders are less uniformly positive than studies in otherwise healthy adults.
